formulas.minute_gain: world.pop * expm1(world.growth / 100 / (365.2425 * 24 * 60)); evaluated at 2025-07-01 model anchor, not current time
formulas.sydney_gap: Sydney.pg - Sydney.p; record difference only, dates/definitions not aligned
formulas.tur_natural_per_thousand: TUR.birthRate - TUR.deathRate; both 2024 per thousand midyear population
formulas.urban_ratio: cities/TUR.json Istanbul.pun / cities/AUS.json Sydney.p; both UN WUP 2025 urban centres
formulas.istanbul_gap: Istanbul.p - Istanbul.pun; difference between records only, not population outside an urban boundary
formulas.vintage_gap: timeline.world[years.index(2025)] - world.world.pop; same target year, different source layers
formulas.japan_dependency: JPN.age65up / japan_middle * 100; per 100 aged 15–64, not per 100 workers
